id-20261103-news-3.title: Digital Scams Are On the Rise: Quick Steps to Report to OJK IASC, Block Accounts, and Chances of Fund Recovery

segments.src: Penipuan digital terus berkembang seiring makin lazimnya transaksi lewat ponsel.
segments.tr: Digital scams continue to evolve as transactions via mobile phones become more common.

segments.src: Pelaku tidak lagi mengandalkan cara lama.
segments.tr: Perpetuators no longer rely on old methods.

segments.src: Mereka memakai tautan palsu, aplikasi APK berbahaya, hingga tawaran investasi bodong yang tampak meyakinkan.
segments.tr: They use fake links, malicious APK applications, to convincing bogus investment offers.

segments.src: Artikel ini merangkum langkah yang perlu dilakukan segera setelah menjadi korban, jalur pelaporan resmi, serta cara pencegahan yang paling efektif.
segments.tr: This article summarizes the steps to take immediately after becoming a victim, official reporting channels, and the most effective prevention methods.

segments.src: > **Catatan:** Artikel ini bersifat informasi umum. Nomor kontak, prosedur, dan kebijakan dapat berubah. Selalu pastikan informasi terbaru melalui kanal resmi OJK, Bank Indonesia, bank Anda, dan kepolisian.
segments.tr: > **Note:** This article is for general information. Contact numbers, procedures, and policies are subject to change. Always verify the latest information through official channels of OJK, Bank Indonesia, your bank, and the police.

segments.src: ## Modus yang Paling Sering Ditemui
segments.tr: ## Most Common Modus Operandi

segments.src: ### 1. Tautan palsu (phishing)
segments.tr: ### 1. Fake links (phishing)

segments.src: Korban menerima pesan lewat SMS, WhatsApp, atau email yang mengatasnamakan bank, kurir, atau instansi pemerintah.
segments.tr: Victims receive messages via SMS, WhatsApp, or email impersonating banks, couriers, or government agencies.

segments.src: Isinya biasanya berupa pemberitahuan paket, tagihan, atau akun yang akan diblokir.
segments.tr: The contents are usually notifications about packages, bills, or accounts that will be blocked.

segments.src: Tautan di dalamnya mengarah ke situs tiruan yang meminta data pribadi, nomor kartu, PIN, atau kode OTP.
segments.tr: The links inside lead to fake sites requesting personal data, card numbers, PINs, or OTP codes.

segments.src: ### 2. APK berbahaya
segments.tr: ### 2. Malicious APKs

segments.src: Pelaku mengirim file berekstensi .apk, misalnya berkedok "surat undangan", "foto paket", atau "cek tagihan".
segments.tr: Perpetrators send files with the .apk extension, for example disguised as "wedding invitations", "package photos", or "bill checks".

segments.src: Jika dipasang, aplikasi ini dapat membaca SMS, mengintip notifikasi, atau mengambil alih layar sehingga kode OTP dan akses aplikasi perbankan bisa disalahgunakan.
segments.tr: If installed, these applications can read SMS, peek at notifications, or take over the screen so that OTP codes and banking application access can be misused.

segments.src: ### 3. Investasi bodong
segments.tr: ### 3. Bogus investments

segments.src: Ciri umumnya adalah janji keuntungan tinggi dalam waktu singkat, tanpa risiko, dan disertai tekanan untuk segera menyetor dana.
segments.tr: The general characteristic is the promise of high returns in a short time, risk-free, and accompanied by pressure to immediately deposit funds.

segments.src: Sering kali korban diajak masuk grup percakapan berisi testimoni palsu.
segments.tr: Often victims are invited to join chat groups containing fake testimonials.

segments.src: Awalnya "keuntungan" kecil dicairkan agar korban percaya, lalu diminta menyetor lebih besar.
segments.tr: Initially small "profits" are disbursed to make victims believe, then they are asked to deposit larger amounts.

segments.src: ### 4. Modus lain
segments.tr: ### 4. Other modes

segments.src: - Penipuan berkedok hadiah atau undian.
segments.tr: - Scams disguised as prizes or lotteries.

segments.src: - Pinjaman online ilegal yang meminta biaya di muka.
segments.tr: - Illegal online loans that charge upfront fees.

segments.src: - Pengambilalihan akun melalui rekayasa sosial (social engineering), misalnya pelaku mengaku petugas bank atau layanan pelanggan.
segments.tr: - Account takeovers through social engineering, for example perpetrators claiming to be bank officers or customer service.

segments.src: ## Langkah Cepat Setelah Menjadi Korban
segments.tr: ## Quick Steps After Becoming a Victim

segments.src: Kecepatan adalah faktor penting.
segments.tr: Speed is an important factor.

segments.src: Semakin cepat Anda bertindak, semakin besar peluang dana yang berpindah dapat ditahan sebelum dipindahkan lagi.
segments.tr: The faster you act, the greater the chance that transferred funds can be intercepted before being moved again.

segments.src: 1. **Tetap tenang dan hentikan komunikasi.** Jangan membalas pelaku, jangan mengirim tambahan dana, dan jangan tergiur tawaran "pengembalian dana" dari pihak yang tidak jelas.
segments.tr: 1. **Stay calm and stop communication.** Do not reply to perpetrators, do not send additional funds, and do not be tempted by "fund recovery" offers from unclear parties.

segments.src: 2. **Hubungi bank atau penyedia dompet digital Anda segera.** Gunakan nomor layanan pelanggan resmi yang tertera di kartu atau aplikasi resmi. Minta pemblokiran kartu, penonaktifan mobile banking, dan penahanan transaksi bila memungkinkan.
segments.tr: 2. **Contact your bank or digital wallet provider immediately.** Use the official customer service number listed on your card or official app. Request card blocking, deactivation of mobile banking, and holding of transactions if possible.

segments.src: 3. **Lindungi akun dan perangkat.** Ganti PIN dan kata sandi dari perangkat yang aman. Jika sempat memasang APK mencurigakan, putuskan koneksi internet, hapus aplikasi tersebut, dan pertimbangkan mengembalikan ponsel ke pengaturan pabrik setelah mencadangkan data penting.
segments.tr: 3. **Protect accounts and devices.** Change PINs and passwords from a secure device. If you accidentally installed a suspicious APK, disconnect the internet, delete the application, and consider resetting your phone to factory settings after backing up important data.

segments.src: 4. **Kumpulkan bukti.** Simpan tangkapan layar percakapan, nomor telepon pelaku, tautan, nomor rekening tujuan, bukti transfer, waktu kejadian, dan nominal kerugian. Jangan menghapus pesan apa pun.
segments.tr: 4. **Collect evidence.** Save screenshots of conversations, perpetrator phone numbers, links, destination account numbers, transfer proof, time of incident, and nominal losses. Do not delete any messages.

segments.src: 5. **Segera laporkan** melalui jalur resmi seperti dijelaskan di bawah.
segments.tr: 5. **Report immediately** through official channels as explained below.

segments.src: ## Melapor ke IASC OJK
segments.tr: ## Reporting to OJK IASC

segments.src: Indonesia Anti-Scam Centre (IASC) adalah pusat penanganan penipuan transaksi keuangan yang dikoordinasikan OJK bersama Bank Indonesia, kepolisian, kementerian terkait, serta industri perbankan dan sistem pembayaran.
segments.tr: The Indonesia Anti-Scam Centre (IASC) is a financial transaction scam handling center coordinated by OJK together with Bank Indonesia, the police, relevant ministries, and the banking and payment system industry.

segments.src: Tujuannya mempercepat penelusuran dan pemblokiran rekening yang dipakai untuk menampung dana hasil penipuan.
segments.tr: Its purpose is to accelerate the tracking and blocking of accounts used to accommodate funds resulting from fraud.

segments.src: **Gambaran umum alur pelaporan:**
segments.tr: **Overview of the reporting flow:**

segments.src: 1. Siapkan identitas diri, kronologi singkat, dan bukti-bukti yang sudah dikumpulkan.
segments.tr: 1. Prepare your identity, a brief chronology, and evidence that has been collected.

segments.src: 2. Ajukan laporan melalui kanal resmi IASC yang diumumkan OJK. Periksa alamat situs dan nomor kontak langsung di situs resmi OJK (ojk.go.id) agar tidak terjebak kanal palsu.
segments.tr: 2. Submit a report through official IASC channels announced by OJK. Check the site address and direct contact numbers on the official OJK website (ojk.go.id) so you do not get trapped by fake channels.

segments.src: 3. Catat nomor laporan atau tiket sebagai rujukan tindak lanjut.
segments.tr: 3. Note the report or ticket number as a reference for follow-up.

segments.src: 4. Ikuti proses verifikasi. Pihak terkait dapat meminta data tambahan.
segments.tr: 4. Follow the verification process. Relevant parties may request additional data.

segments.src: 5. Laporkan juga ke kepolisian bila diperlukan untuk proses hukum, termasuk melalui kanal pelaporan siber resmi.
segments.tr: 5. Also report to the police if necessary for legal processes, including through official cyber reporting channels.

segments.src: Perlu diingat, IASC berfokus pada penanganan cepat dan pemblokiran rekening.
segments.tr: Keep in mind, IASC focuses on rapid handling and account blocking.

segments.src: Penegakan hukum terhadap pelaku tetap melalui aparat penegak hukum.
segments.tr: Law enforcement against perpetrators remains through law enforcement authorities.

segments.src: ## Pemblokiran Rekening Penampung
segments.tr: ## Blocking Recipient Accounts

segments.src: Rekening yang dipakai pelaku (sering disebut rekening penampung atau "rekening keledai") dapat diblokir sementara oleh bank berdasarkan proses yang berlaku.
segments.tr: Accounts used by perpetrators (often called recipient accounts or "donkey accounts") can be temporarily blocked by banks based on applicable procedures.

segments.src: Hal-hal yang membantu proses ini:
segments.tr: Things that help this process:

segments.src: - Nomor rekening dan nama bank tujuan ditulis dengan benar.
segments.tr: - The account number and destination bank name are written correctly.

segments.src: - Bukti transfer lengkap dan jelas.
segments.tr: - Transfer proof is complete and clear.

segments.src: - Laporan dibuat sesegera mungkin, idealnya dalam hitungan jam sejak kejadian.
segments.tr: - The report is made as soon as possible, ideally within hours of the incident.

segments.src: Pemblokiran bersifat sementara untuk keperluan penelusuran.
segments.tr: Blocking is temporary for tracking purposes.

segments.src: Keputusan lanjutan bergantung pada hasil verifikasi dan proses hukum.
segments.tr: Further decisions depend on the verification results and legal process.

segments.src: ## Peluang Dana Kembali: Realistis, Bukan Janji
segments.tr: ## Chances of Fund Recovery: Realistic, Not a Promise

segments.src: Tidak ada jaminan dana pasti kembali.
segments.tr: There is no guarantee funds will definitely be returned.

segments.src: Peluangnya dipengaruhi beberapa hal:
segments.tr: The chances are influenced by several things:

segments.src: - **Kecepatan melapor.** Jika dana masih berada di rekening tujuan, peluang penahanan lebih besar. Jika sudah ditarik tunai atau dipecah ke banyak rekening, pemulihan jauh lebih sulit.
segments.tr: - **Reporting speed.** If funds are still in the destination account, the chance of holding them is greater. If they have been withdrawn in cash or split into many accounts, recovery is much more difficult.

segments.src: - **Kelengkapan bukti.** Bukti yang rapi mempermudah penelusuran.
segments.tr: - **Completeness of evidence.** Neatly organized evidence facilitates tracking.

segments.src: - **Jenis penipuan.** Transaksi yang dilakukan korban atas kemauan sendiri karena tertipu umumnya lebih sulit diklaim ulang dibanding pembobolan yang tidak disadari korban.
segments.tr: - **Type of scam.** Transactions carried out by victims of their own free will because they were fooled are generally harder to reclaim compared to hacks that victims were unaware of.

segments.src: - **Proses hukum.** Pengembalian dana lewat jalur hukum dapat memakan waktu panjang.
segments.tr: - **Legal process.** Recovering funds through legal channels can take a long time.

segments.src: Waspadai pihak yang mengaku sebagai "jasa pemulihan dana" dan meminta biaya di muka.
segments.tr: Beware of parties claiming to be "fund recovery services" and requesting upfront fees.

segments.src: Ini sering kali merupakan penipuan lanjutan terhadap korban yang sama.
segments.tr: This is often a follow-up scam against the same victim.

segments.src: ## Pencegahan yang Paling Efektif
segments.tr: ## Most Effective Prevention

segments.src: - **Jangan klik tautan dari pengirim tak dikenal.** Buka aplikasi atau situs resmi secara langsung, bukan lewat tautan di pesan.
segments.tr: - **Do not click links from unknown senders.** Open official applications or sites directly, not via links in messages.

segments.src: - **Jangan memasang file APK dari luar toko aplikasi resmi.** Nonaktifkan izin pemasangan dari sumber tidak dikenal.
segments.tr: - **Do not install APK files from outside official app stores.** Disable installation permissions from unknown sources.

segments.src: - **Jangan pernah membagikan OTP, PIN, atau kata sandi** kepada siapa pun, termasuk yang mengaku petugas bank. Bank resmi tidak meminta data tersebut.
segments.tr: - **Never share OTPs, PINs, or passwords** with anyone, including those claiming to be bank officers. Official banks do not ask for such data.

segments.src: - **Aktifkan autentikasi dua langkah** dan notifikasi transaksi.
segments.tr: - **Enable two-factor authentication** and transaction notifications.

segments.src: - **Atur batas transaksi harian** pada aplikasi perbankan agar kerugian dapat dibatasi.
segments.tr: - **Set daily transaction limits** on banking apps so losses can be limited.

segments.src: - **Periksa legalitas investasi.** Pastikan perusahaan dan produknya terdaftar atau berizin di OJK, dan waspadai imbal hasil yang tidak masuk akal.
segments.tr: - **Check investment legality.** Ensure the company and its products are registered or licensed with OJK, and beware of unreasonable returns.

segments.src: - **Verifikasi ulang sebelum transfer.** Hubungi pihak terkait lewat nomor resmi, terutama bila ada permintaan mendesak.
segments.tr: - **Re-verify before transferring.** Contact relevant parties via official numbers, especially if there are urgent requests.

segments.src: - **Edukasi keluarga**, terutama orang tua dan anggota keluarga yang baru mengenal layanan keuangan digital.
segments.tr: - **Educate family**, especially parents and family members who are just getting acquainted with digital financial services.

segments.src: ## Ringkasan
segments.tr: ## Summary

segments.src: Penipuan digital menyasar siapa saja, dan pelaku terus mengubah cara kerjanya.
segments.tr: Digital scams target anyone, and perpetrators continue to change their methods.

segments.src: Jika menjadi korban, segera hubungi bank, amankan akun dan perangkat, kumpulkan bukti, lalu lapor melalui IASC OJK dan kepolisian.
segments.tr: If you become a victim, contact your bank immediately, secure accounts and devices, collect evidence, and report via OJK IASC and the police.

segments.src: Peluang dana kembali sangat bergantung pada kecepatan dan kelengkapan laporan, sehingga tidak ada jaminan.
segments.tr: The chances of funds returning depend heavily on the speed and completeness of the report, so there is no guarantee.

segments.src: Kewaspadaan dan kebiasaan aman bertransaksi tetap menjadi perlindungan terbaik.
segments.tr: Vigilance and safe transaction habits remain the best protection.

id-20261103-news-1.title: Heroes' Day November 10, 2026: The Meaning of Heroism in the Present Era and How Ordinary Citizens Can Carry It On

segments.src: Setiap tanggal 10 November, bangsa Indonesia memperingati Hari Pahlawan.
segments.tr: Every November 10, the Indonesian nation commemorates Heroes' Day.

segments.src: Tahun ini, peringatan jatuh pada Selasa, 10 November 2026.
segments.tr: This year, the commemoration falls on Tuesday, November 10, 2026.

segments.src: Upacara bendera, ziarah ke taman makam pahlawan, dan kegiatan sekolah sudah menjadi pemandangan rutin.
segments.tr: Flag ceremonies, pilgrimages to heroes' cemeteries, and school activities have become a routine sight.

segments.src: Namun, di luar seremoni itu, ada pertanyaan yang layak kita renungkan: apa arti menjadi pahlawan hari ini, dan apa yang bisa dilakukan warga biasa?
segments.tr: However, beyond those ceremonies, there is a question worth reflecting on: what does it mean to be a hero today, and what can ordinary citizens do?

segments.src: Artikel ini mengulas latar sejarah Pertempuran Surabaya, cara negara menetapkan seseorang sebagai pahlawan nasional, serta contoh kepahlawanan sehari-hari yang dapat dilakukan siapa saja.
segments.tr: This article reviews the historical background of the Battle of Surabaya, how the state designates someone as a national hero, and examples of everyday heroism that anyone can perform.

segments.src: ## Mengapa 10 November?
segments.tr: ## Why November 10?

segments.src: Tanggal 10 November merujuk pada pertempuran besar di Surabaya pada 1945, hanya beberapa bulan setelah Proklamasi Kemerdekaan 17 Agustus 1945.
segments.tr: The date November 10 refers to the major battle in Surabaya in 1945, just a few months after the Proclamation of Independence on August 17, 1945.

segments.src: Pada masa itu, pasukan Sekutu datang ke Indonesia dengan tugas melucuti tentara Jepang dan mengurus tawanan perang.
segments.tr: At that time, Allied forces came to Indonesia with the task of disarming Japanese soldiers and managing prisoners of war.

segments.src: Banyak warga khawatir kedatangan mereka juga membawa kembali pemerintahan kolonial Belanda.
segments.tr: Many citizens were worried that their arrival would also bring back the Dutch colonial government.

segments.src: Beberapa peristiwa penting menjelang pertempuran antara lain:
segments.tr: Some important events leading up to the battle include:

segments.src: - **Akhir September 1945:** Insiden di Hotel Yamato (kini Hotel Majapahit) di Surabaya, ketika bendera Belanda dikibarkan dan memicu kemarahan warga. Bendera itu kemudian disobek bagian birunya sehingga tersisa merah putih.
segments.tr: - **Late September 1945:** The incident at Hotel Yamato (now Hotel Majapahit) in Surabaya, when the Dutch flag was raised and sparked public anger. The flag was then torn, removing the blue part so that only red and white remained.

segments.src: - **22 Oktober 1945:** Para ulama Nahdlatul Ulama, dipimpin KH Hasyim Asy'ari, menyerukan Resolusi Jihad yang menyatakan bahwa membela tanah air adalah kewajiban.
segments.tr: - **October 22, 1945:** Nahdlatul Ulama scholars, led by KH Hasyim Asy'ari, called for the Jihad Resolution, which stated that defending the homeland is an obligation.

segments.src: - **27–30 Oktober 1945:** Bentrokan antara pasukan Indonesia dan pasukan Inggris pecah. Pada 30 Oktober, Brigadir Jenderal A.W.S. Mallaby, komandan pasukan Inggris di Surabaya, tewas.
segments.tr: - **October 27–30, 1945:** Clashes between Indonesian forces and British forces broke out. On October 30, Brigadier General A.W.S. Mallaby, the commander of British forces in Surabaya, was killed.

segments.src: - **9 November 1945:** Pihak Inggris mengeluarkan ultimatum agar pihak Indonesia menyerahkan senjata. Gubernur Jawa Timur saat itu, R.M.T.A. Suryo, bersama para pemimpin lain menolaknya.
segments.tr: - **November 9, 1945:** The British side issued an ultimatum for the Indonesian side to surrender their weapons. The Governor of East Java at the time, R.M.T.A. Suryo, along with other leaders, rejected it.

segments.src: - **10 November 1945:** Pertempuran besar dimulai dan berlangsung selama berminggu-minggu. Siaran radio Bung Tomo membakar semangat para pejuang dan rakyat.
segments.tr: - **November 10, 1945:** The major battle began and lasted for weeks. Bung Tomo's radio broadcasts ignited the spirit of the fighters and the people.

segments.src: Jumlah korban dalam pertempuran ini berbeda-beda menurut sumber, sehingga para sejarawan umumnya menyebutnya sebagai perkiraan.
segments.tr: The number of casualties in this battle varies according to sources, so historians generally refer to them as estimates.

segments.src: Yang disepakati, Surabaya mengalami kerusakan besar dan banyak pejuang maupun warga sipil gugur.
segments.tr: What is agreed upon is that Surabaya suffered great damage and many fighters and civilians fell.

segments.src: Pertempuran ini kemudian menjadi simbol tekad bangsa Indonesia mempertahankan kemerdekaan, sehingga Surabaya dijuluki Kota Pahlawan.
segments.tr: This battle later became a symbol of the Indonesian nation's determination to defend independence, which is why Surabaya is nicknamed the City of Heroes.

segments.src: Penetapan 10 November sebagai Hari Pahlawan dilakukan melalui Keputusan Presiden Nomor 316 Tahun 1959.
segments.tr: The designation of November 10 as Heroes' Day was carried out through Presidential Decree Number 316 of 1959.

segments.src: ## Bagaimana Gelar Pahlawan Nasional Ditetapkan?
segments.tr: ## How is the National Hero Title Determined?

segments.src: Gelar Pahlawan Nasional tidak diberikan sembarangan.
segments.tr: The title of National Hero is not given carelessly.

segments.src: Ketentuannya diatur dalam Undang-Undang Nomor 20 Tahun 2009 tentang Gelar, Tanda Jasa, dan Tanda Kehormatan.
segments.tr: The provisions are regulated in Law Number 20 of 2009 concerning Titles, Medals of Merit, and Honors.

segments.src: Secara garis besar, prosesnya sebagai berikut:
segments.tr: Broadly speaking, the process is as follows:

segments.src: 1. **Pengusulan dari masyarakat.** Usulan dapat datang dari perorangan, keluarga, organisasi, akademisi, atau pemerintah daerah.
segments.tr: 1. **Proposal from the community.** Proposals can come from individuals, families, organizations, academics, or local governments.

segments.src: 2. **Pengkajian di daerah.** Tim peneliti dan pengkaji gelar di tingkat kabupaten/kota dan provinsi memeriksa riwayat hidup, jasa, serta dokumen pendukung.
segments.tr: 2. **Review at the regional level.** The title research and review team at the regency/city and provincial levels examines the biography, services, and supporting documents.

segments.src: 3. **Pengkajian di tingkat pusat.** Usulan yang lolos diteruskan ke Kementerian Sosial dan tim pengkaji pusat yang melibatkan sejarawan dan para ahli.
segments.tr: 3. **Review at the central level.** Proposals that pass are forwarded to the Ministry of Social Affairs and the central review team, which involves historians and experts.

segments.src: 4. **Pertimbangan Dewan Gelar.** Dewan Gelar, Tanda Jasa, dan Tanda Kehormatan memberikan pertimbangan kepada Presiden.
segments.tr: 4. **Consideration by the Title Council.** The Council for Titles, Medals of Merit, and Honors provides consideration to the President.

segments.src: 5. **Penetapan oleh Presiden.** Gelar secara resmi dianugerahkan melalui keputusan Presiden, biasanya menjelang atau pada peringatan Hari Pahlawan.
segments.tr: 5. **Determination by the President.** The title is officially awarded through a Presidential decree, usually leading up to or on the commemoration of Heroes' Day.

segments.src: Syarat umumnya mencakup berstatus warga negara Indonesia, memiliki rekam jejak perjuangan atau karya luar biasa bagi bangsa, berintegritas moral dan keteladanan, serta setia dan tidak mengkhianati bangsa dan negara.
segments.tr: General requirements include being an Indonesian citizen, having a track record of struggle or extraordinary work for the nation, possessing moral integrity and being a role model, and being loyal and not betraying the nation and state.

segments.src: Cakupannya tidak hanya pejuang bersenjata.
segments.tr: The scope is not limited to armed fighters.

segments.src: Tokoh pendidikan, pergerakan, diplomasi, hingga pemikiran juga pernah dianugerahi gelar ini.
segments.tr: Figures in education, movements, diplomacy, and even thought have also been awarded this title.

segments.src: Karena itu, kisah pahlawan nasional sering kali berasal dari berbagai latar belakang daerah, agama, dan profesi.
segments.tr: Therefore, the stories of national heroes often come from various regional, religious, and professional backgrounds.

segments.src: ## Kepahlawanan di Era Sekarang
segments.tr: ## Heroism in the Present Era

segments.src: Kita hidup di masa yang berbeda.
segments.tr: We live in a different time.

segments.src: Tantangan bangsa kini bukan lagi penjajahan bersenjata, melainkan hal-hal seperti kesenjangan pendidikan, bencana alam, informasi yang menyesatkan, masalah lingkungan, dan menurunnya kepedulian sosial.
segments.tr: The nation's challenges are no longer armed colonization, but things like educational inequality, natural disasters, misleading information, environmental issues, and declining social concern.

segments.src: Meski bentuknya berubah, nilai dasar kepahlawanan tetap sama: keberanian, pengorbanan, kejujuran, dan keberpihakan pada kepentingan bersama.
segments.tr: Although the form changes, the basic values of heroism remain the same: courage, sacrifice, honesty, and alignment with the common interest.

segments.src: Pahlawan masa kini tidak selalu tercatat dalam buku sejarah.
segments.tr: Heroes of today are not always recorded in history books.

segments.src: Mereka bisa berupa guru yang tetap mengajar di daerah terpencil, tenaga kesehatan yang bekerja di garis depan saat wabah, relawan yang membantu korban banjir, atau petugas kebersihan yang menjaga kota tetap layak huni.
segments.tr: They can be teachers who continue to teach in remote areas, health workers working on the front lines during an outbreak, volunteers helping flood victims, or sanitation workers who keep the city livable.

segments.src: ## Contoh Kepahlawanan Sehari-hari yang Bisa Dilakukan Siapa Saja
segments.tr: ## Examples of Everyday Heroism That Anyone Can Do

segments.src: Tidak perlu tindakan besar untuk meneruskan semangat para pahlawan.
segments.tr: It does not take grand actions to carry on the spirit of the heroes.

segments.src: Berikut beberapa langkah sederhana:
segments.tr: Here are some simple steps:

segments.src: - **Bersikap jujur dan disiplin.** Tidak menyontek, tidak menerima atau memberi suap, taat aturan lalu lintas, dan menepati janji adalah bentuk integritas yang menjadi fondasi bangsa.
segments.tr: - **Be honest and disciplined.** Not cheating, not accepting or giving bribes, obeying traffic rules, and keeping promises are forms of integrity that form the foundation of the nation.

segments.src: - **Menyaring informasi sebelum membagikannya.** Periksa sumber berita, bandingkan dengan media tepercaya, dan jangan ikut menyebarkan kabar yang belum jelas kebenarannya. Ini bentuk pembelaan terhadap ruang publik yang sehat.
segments.tr: - **Filter information before sharing it.** Check the news source, compare it with trusted media, and do not participate in spreading news whose truth is unclear. This is a form of defense for a healthy public space.

segments.src: - **Membantu sesama.** Menjadi relawan, mendonasikan waktu atau tenaga, mengajar anak-anak di lingkungan sekitar, atau sekadar menengok tetangga yang sedang kesulitan.
segments.tr: - **Help others.** Becoming a volunteer, donating time or energy, teaching children in the surrounding neighborhood, or just checking on a neighbor who is having trouble.

segments.src: - **Menjaga lingkungan.** Mengurangi sampah plastik, menghemat air dan listrik, serta menanam pohon adalah investasi bagi generasi mendatang.
segments.tr: - **Protect the environment.** Reducing plastic waste, saving water and electricity, and planting trees are investments for future generations.

segments.src: - **Mendukung usaha lokal.** Membeli dari pelaku UMKM di sekitar kita ikut menggerakkan ekonomi masyarakat.
segments.tr: - **Support local businesses.** Buying from MSMEs around us helps drive the community economy.

segments.src: - **Menghargai perbedaan.** Persatuan yang diperjuangkan para pendahulu perlu dijaga lewat sikap saling menghormati antarsuku, agama, dan pandangan.
segments.tr: - **Respect differences.** The unity fought for by our predecessors needs to be maintained through mutual respect between tribes, religions, and viewpoints.

segments.src: - **Mempelajari sejarah.** Membaca buku, mengunjungi museum, atau mendengarkan cerita kakek-nenek tentang masa perjuangan membuat kita memahami harga kemerdekaan.
segments.tr: - **Study history.** Reading books, visiting museums, or listening to grandparents' stories about the struggle era makes us understand the price of independence.

segments.src: - **Menunaikan hak dan kewajiban sebagai warga.** Membayar pajak, ikut menjaga keamanan lingkungan, dan berpartisipasi dalam kegiatan kemasyarakatan.
segments.tr: - **Fulfill rights and obligations as citizens.** Paying taxes, participating in maintaining neighborhood security, and participating in community activities.

segments.src: ## Cara Memperingati Hari Pahlawan dengan Bermakna
segments.tr: ## How to Commemorate Heroes' Day Meaningfully

segments.src: Peringatan tidak harus mahal atau megah.
segments.tr: Commemoration does not have to be expensive or grand.

segments.src: Beberapa ide yang bisa dicoba:
segments.tr: Some ideas to try:

segments.src: 1. Mengikuti upacara atau mengheningkan cipta bersama keluarga, sekolah, atau tempat kerja.
segments.tr: 1. Participating in a ceremony or a moment of silence with family, school, or workplace.

segments.src: 2. Berziarah ke taman makam pahlawan terdekat dan membersihkannya bersama warga.
segments.tr: 2. Making a pilgrimage to the nearest heroes' cemetery and cleaning it with residents.

segments.src: 3. Mencari tahu tokoh pahlawan dari daerah sendiri, lalu menceritakannya kepada anak-anak.
segments.tr: 3. Finding out about hero figures from your own region, then telling their stories to children.

segments.src: 4. Mengadakan kegiatan sosial, seperti donor darah, bersih-bersih lingkungan, atau bakti sosial.
segments.tr: 4. Organizing social activities, such as blood donation, environmental cleanup, or social service.

segments.src: 5. Menuliskan ucapan terima kasih kepada orang di sekitar yang telah berjasa dalam hidup kita, seperti guru, tenaga medis, atau petugas lapangan.
segments.tr: 5. Writing thank-you notes to people around us who have been instrumental in our lives, such as teachers, medical personnel, or field workers.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Closing

segments.src: Hari Pahlawan bukan sekadar mengenang pertempuran di masa lalu.
segments.tr: Heroes' Day is not just about remembering battles in the past.

segments.src: Peringatan ini mengajak kita bertanya pada diri sendiri: kontribusi apa yang bisa saya berikan hari ini untuk lingkungan dan bangsa?
segments.tr: This commemoration invites us to ask ourselves: what contribution can I make today for the environment and the nation?

segments.src: Para pejuang 1945 telah menyerahkan yang terbaik pada zamannya.
segments.tr: The fighters of 1945 gave their best in their time.

segments.src: Tugas kita adalah mengisi kemerdekaan dengan tindakan nyata sesuai kemampuan masing-masing.
segments.tr: Our task is to fill independence with concrete actions according to our respective abilities.

segments.src: Dari hal kecil yang dilakukan secara konsisten, semangat kepahlawanan tetap hidup.
segments.tr: From small things done consistently, the spirit of heroism remains alive.

id-20261103-news-2.title: Non-Subsidized Fuel Prices and World Oil: How to Read Monthly Adjustments and Their Impact on Transportation Costs

segments.src: Setiap awal bulan, perhatian banyak pengendara tertuju pada papan harga di SPBU.
segments.tr: At the beginning of every month, the attention of many drivers turns to the price boards at gas stations.

segments.src: Harga BBM nonsubsidi seperti Pertamax dan Dexlite sering berubah dari satu bulan ke bulan berikutnya.
segments.tr: Non-subsidized fuel prices such as Pertamax and Dexlite often change from one month to the next.

segments.src: Perubahan ini bukan keputusan acak.
segments.tr: These changes are not random decisions.

segments.src: Ada pola dan komponen yang bisa dipahami, sehingga masyarakat dapat memperkirakan arah harga dan menyiapkan anggaran dengan lebih tenang.
segments.tr: There are patterns and components that can be understood, enabling the public to anticipate price trends and prepare budgets with greater peace of mind.

segments.src: Artikel ini bersifat edukatif.
segments.tr: This article is educational in nature.

segments.src: Angka harga di sini tidak disebutkan karena berubah setiap periode.
segments.tr: Price figures are not mentioned here because they change every period.

segments.src: Untuk harga terbaru, rujuklah pengumuman resmi badan usaha penyedia BBM atau aplikasi resminya.
segments.tr: For the latest prices, please refer to the official announcements of fuel provider business entities or their official applications.

segments.src: ## BBM Subsidi dan Nonsubsidi: Apa Bedanya?
segments.tr: ## Subsidized and Non-Subsidized Fuel: What's the Difference?

segments.src: Di Indonesia, bahan bakar minyak dikelompokkan menjadi beberapa jenis berdasarkan cara penetapan harganya.
segments.tr: In Indonesia, fuel oil is grouped into several types based on how its prices are determined.

segments.src: - **BBM bersubsidi atau penugasan.** Harga jual eceran jenis ini ditetapkan pemerintah dan relatif stabil dalam jangka panjang. Selisih antara harga keekonomian dan harga jual ditanggung melalui anggaran negara atau mekanisme kompensasi. Penyalurannya diatur melalui ketentuan tertentu, termasuk pembatasan penerima dan volume.
segments.tr: - **Subsidized or assigned fuel.** The retail selling price of this type is set by the government and remains relatively stable in the long term. The difference between the economic price and the selling price is borne through the state budget or a compensation mechanism. Its distribution is regulated through specific provisions, including restrictions on recipients and volume.

segments.src: - **BBM nonsubsidi.** Harganya mengikuti mekanisme pasar dan disesuaikan secara berkala oleh badan usaha. Karena tidak ada selisih yang ditanggung negara, perubahan harga bahan baku akan lebih cepat terasa di tingkat konsumen.
segments.tr: - **Non-subsidized fuel.** Its price follows market mechanisms and is adjusted periodically by business entities. Because there is no difference borne by the state, changes in raw material prices are felt more quickly at the consumer level.

segments.src: Dengan kata lain, harga BBM nonsubsidi lebih "jujur" mencerminkan kondisi pasar energi global, sedangkan harga BBM bersubsidi lebih banyak dipengaruhi kebijakan fiskal.
segments.tr: In other words, non-subsidized fuel prices more "honestly" reflect global energy market conditions, while subsidized fuel prices are influenced much more by fiscal policy.

segments.src: ## Rumus Dasar: Dari Minyak Mentah sampai Pompa SPBU
segments.tr: ## Basic Formula: From Crude Oil to Gas Station Pumps

segments.src: Secara sederhana, harga BBM nonsubsidi dibentuk dari beberapa komponen berikut.
segments.tr: Simply put, non-subsidized fuel prices are formed from several of the following components.

segments.src: 1. **Harga acuan produk minyak.** Untuk bensin dan solar, acuan yang lazim dipakai adalah harga produk di pasar regional, misalnya kuotasi Mean of Platts Singapore (MOPS). Harga ini sangat dipengaruhi harga minyak mentah dunia, tetapi tidak selalu bergerak persis sama karena ada faktor pasokan dan permintaan produk olahan.
segments.tr: 1. **Oil product reference price.** For gasoline and diesel, the commonly used reference is the price of products in the regional market, such as the Mean of Platts Singapore (MOPS) quotation. This price is heavily influenced by world crude oil prices, but does not always move in exact tandem due to supply and demand factors for refined products.

segments.src: 2. **Nilai tukar rupiah.** Transaksi minyak dilakukan dalam dolar AS. Ketika rupiah melemah, biaya impor dalam rupiah naik walaupun harga dalam dolar tidak berubah.
segments.tr: 2. **Rupiah exchange rate.** Oil transactions are conducted in US dollars. When the rupiah weakens, import costs in rupiah rise even if the price in dollars remains unchanged.

segments.src: 3. **Biaya distribusi dan logistik.** Meliputi pengapalan, penyimpanan di terminal, hingga pengangkutan ke SPBU. Wilayah yang lebih jauh umumnya punya biaya lebih tinggi.
segments.tr: 3. **Distribution and logistics costs.** Covering shipping, terminal storage, and transportation to gas stations. Regions farther away generally incur higher costs.

segments.src: 4. **Margin badan usaha.** Bagian untuk menutup operasional dan keuntungan penyalur.
segments.tr: 4. **Business entity margin.** The portion to cover operations and the distributor's profit.

segments.src: 5. **Pajak.** Terdiri atas Pajak Pertambahan Nilai (PPN) dan pajak bahan bakar kendaraan bermotor (PBBKB) yang tarifnya ditetapkan pemerintah daerah dalam batas yang diatur.
segments.tr: 5. **Taxes.** Consisting of Value Added Tax (VAT) and motor vehicle fuel tax (PBBKB), the rates of which are set by local governments within regulated limits.

segments.src: Bentuk umumnya dapat dituliskan sebagai berikut:
segments.tr: The general form can be written as follows:

segments.src: > Harga eceran ≈ (Harga acuan produk × Kurs) + Biaya distribusi + Margin + Pajak
segments.tr: > Retail price ≈ (Product reference price × Exchange rate) + Distribution costs + Margin + Taxes

segments.src: Rumus ini hanya penyederhanaan.
segments.tr: This formula is merely a simplification.

segments.src: Praktiknya, tiap badan usaha memiliki metode perhitungan dan periode rata-rata acuan sendiri.
segments.tr: In practice, each business entity has its own calculation methods and reference averaging period.

segments.src: ## Mengapa Disesuaikan Setiap Bulan?
segments.tr: ## Why Are They Adjusted Every Month?

segments.src: Harga minyak dunia bergerak setiap hari, bahkan setiap jam.
segments.tr: World oil prices move every day, even every hour.

segments.src: Jika harga eceran ikut berubah harian, konsumen akan kesulitan merencanakan pengeluaran.
segments.tr: If retail prices changed daily, consumers would find it difficult to plan their expenses.

segments.src: Karena itu, badan usaha biasanya memakai rata-rata harga acuan dalam periode tertentu, lalu menetapkan harga baru untuk satu bulan ke depan.
segments.tr: Therefore, business entities typically use the average reference price over a certain period, then set a new price for the upcoming month.

segments.src: Akibatnya ada jeda waktu.
segments.tr: As a result, there is a time lag.

segments.src: Kenaikan atau penurunan harga minyak dunia pada bulan ini umumnya baru terlihat di SPBU pada penyesuaian bulan berikutnya.
segments.tr: An increase or decrease in world oil prices this month generally only becomes visible at gas stations during the following month's adjustment.

segments.src: Jeda ini juga menjelaskan mengapa harga di SPBU kadang tidak langsung turun ketika berita harga minyak dunia sedang melemah.
segments.tr: This lag also explains why gas station prices sometimes do not drop immediately when news breaks that world oil prices are weakening.

segments.src: ## Cara Praktis Membaca Arah Harga
segments.tr: ## Practical Ways to Read Price Trends

segments.src: Anda tidak perlu menjadi analis energi untuk membuat perkiraan kasar.
segments.tr: You do not need to be an energy analyst to make a rough estimate.

segments.src: Beberapa langkah berikut dapat membantu.
segments.tr: The following steps can help.

segments.src: - **Perhatikan tren harga minyak dunia selama satu bulan terakhir**, bukan hanya berita satu hari. Karena memakai rata-rata, tren sebulan lebih relevan.
segments.tr: - **Pay attention to world oil price trends over the past month**, not just one day's news. Because averages are used, a month-long trend is more relevant.

segments.src: - **Cermati pergerakan kurs rupiah terhadap dolar AS.** Minyak yang turun bisa saja "dimakan" pelemahan rupiah.
segments.tr: - **Examine the movement of the rupiah exchange rate against the US dollar.** Falling oil prices can easily be "eaten up" by a weakening rupiah.

segments.src: - **Bedakan jenis BBM.** Bensin dan solar memiliki dinamika harga acuan yang berbeda, sehingga arah perubahannya tidak selalu sama.
segments.tr: - **Differentiate between fuel types.** Gasoline and diesel have different reference price dynamics, so the direction of their changes is not always the same.

segments.src: - **Baca pengumuman resmi.** Informasi harga resmi diumumkan badan usaha di situs atau aplikasi mereka, biasanya pada awal periode baru.
segments.tr: - **Read official announcements.** Official price information is announced by business entities on their websites or applications, usually at the beginning of a new period.

segments.src: ## Dampak bagi Ongkos Transportasi
segments.tr: ## Impact on Transportation Costs

segments.src: BBM adalah salah satu komponen biaya terbesar dalam transportasi.
segments.tr: Fuel is one of the largest cost components in transportation.

segments.src: Pengaruhnya bergantung pada jenis kendaraan dan bahan bakar yang dipakai.
segments.tr: Its impact depends on the type of vehicle and fuel used.

segments.src: - **Kendaraan pribadi.** Pengguna BBM nonsubsidi langsung merasakan perubahan pada biaya isi tangki. Bagi pengguna harian, selisih kecil per liter dapat terakumulasi menjadi perbedaan nyata dalam sebulan.
segments.tr: - **Private vehicles.** Non-subsidized fuel users directly feel changes in tank-filling costs. For daily users, a small difference per liter can accumulate into a noticeable difference over a month.

segments.src: - **Transportasi daring.** Tarif dasar ditetapkan sesuai regulasi dan penyedia layanan, sehingga perubahan harga BBM tidak selalu langsung tercermin pada tarif. Namun tekanan biaya bisa memengaruhi pendapatan bersih pengemudi.
segments.tr: - **Ride-hailing transportation.** Base fares are set according to regulations and service providers, so fuel price changes are not always immediately reflected in fares. However, cost pressures can affect drivers' net earnings.

segments.src: - **Angkutan umum.** Tarif angkutan umum kota dan antarkota biasanya diatur pemerintah daerah atau pusat. Penyesuaian tarif umumnya melewati pembahasan dan tidak terjadi otomatis setiap bulan.
segments.tr: - **Public transportation.** City and intercity public transport fares are usually regulated by local or central governments. Fare adjustments generally go through discussions and do not happen automatically every month.

segments.src: - **Angkutan barang.** Truk dan kendaraan logistik banyak memakai solar. Jika biaya bahan bakar jenis ini naik, biaya pengiriman cenderung ikut terdorong, terutama pada rute jarak jauh.
segments.tr: - **Freight transport.** Trucks and logistics vehicles heavily use diesel. If the cost of this fuel type rises, delivery costs tend to be pushed up as well, especially on long-distance routes.

segments.src: Perlu dicatat bahwa pengguna BBM bersubsidi tidak terkena dampak langsung dari penyesuaian bulanan harga nonsubsidi.
segments.tr: It is worth noting that subsidized fuel users are not directly affected by the monthly adjustments of non-subsidized prices.

segments.src: Meski demikian, pengaruh tidak langsung tetap mungkin muncul lewat biaya logistik secara umum.
segments.tr: Nevertheless, indirect effects may still arise through general logistics costs.

segments.src: ## Efek Lanjutan ke Harga Pangan
segments.tr: ## Spillover Effects on Food Prices

segments.src: Barang kebutuhan sehari-hari menempuh perjalanan dari kebun, pabrik, atau pelabuhan ke pasar dan warung.
segments.tr: Daily necessities travel a journey from farms, factories, or ports to markets and grocery shops.

segments.src: Biaya angkut menjadi salah satu unsur harga akhir.
segments.tr: Transportation costs are one of the elements of the final price.

segments.src: Karena itu, perubahan biaya bahan bakar dapat ikut memengaruhi harga pangan, khususnya komoditas yang cepat rusak dan harus dikirim jauh, seperti sayur, buah, dan ikan segar.
segments.tr: Therefore, changes in fuel costs can help influence food prices, particularly for perishable commodities that must be shipped far, such as vegetables, fruits, and fresh fish.

segments.src: Meski begitu, dampaknya tidak selalu besar atau seragam.
segments.tr: Even so, the impact is not always large or uniform.

segments.src: Porsi biaya angkut dalam harga akhir berbeda untuk tiap komoditas.
segments.tr: The proportion of transportation costs in the final price varies for each commodity.

segments.src: Faktor lain seperti cuaca, musim panen, dan ketersediaan pasokan sering kali lebih dominan.
segments.tr: Other factors such as weather, harvest seasons, and supply availability are often more dominant.

segments.src: Jadi, kenaikan harga BBM bukan satu-satunya penjelasan ketika harga pangan naik, dan sebaliknya.
segments.tr: Thus, rising fuel prices are not the only explanation when food prices go up, and vice versa.

segments.src: ## Tips Mengelola Pengeluaran Transportasi
segments.tr: ## Tips for Managing Transportation Expenses

segments.src: - Catat konsumsi BBM bulanan agar Anda tahu seberapa besar harga memengaruhi anggaran.
segments.tr: - Record your monthly fuel consumption so you know how much prices affect your budget.

segments.src: - Rawat kendaraan secara rutin. Tekanan ban yang tepat dan servis berkala membantu menjaga efisiensi bahan bakar.
segments.tr: - Maintain your vehicle regularly. Proper tire pressure and routine servicing help maintain fuel efficiency.

segments.src: - Rencanakan rute dan hindari jam macet untuk mengurangi pemakaian bahan bakar.
segments.tr: - Plan routes and avoid traffic congestion hours to reduce fuel consumption.

segments.src: - Pertimbangkan angkutan umum atau berbagi tumpangan untuk perjalanan rutin yang searah.
segments.tr: - Consider public transportation or carpooling for regular trips along the same route.

segments.src: - Sisihkan dana cadangan kecil untuk kemungkinan kenaikan harga pada bulan berikutnya.
segments.tr: - Set aside a small emergency fund for potential price increases in the following month.

segments.src: - Pilih jenis BBM sesuai rekomendasi pabrikan kendaraan Anda, bukan semata karena harga.
segments.tr: - Choose the type of fuel recommended by your vehicle manufacturer, not solely based on price.

segments.src: ## Kesimpulan
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Penyesuaian bulanan harga BBM nonsubsidi mencerminkan gabungan harga acuan minyak dunia, kurs rupiah, biaya distribusi, margin, dan pajak.
segments.tr: The monthly adjustment of non-subsidized fuel prices reflects a combination of world oil reference prices, the rupiah exchange rate, distribution costs, margins, and taxes.

segments.src: Memahami komponen ini membantu kita membaca berita harga dengan lebih kritis, memperkirakan arah perubahan, dan mengatur anggaran transportasi.
segments.tr: Understanding these components helps us read price news more critically, anticipate the direction of changes, and manage transportation budgets.

segments.src: Karena angka selalu bergerak, pastikan Anda merujuk pada informasi resmi untuk harga terbaru, dan perlakukan artikel ini sebagai panduan memahami cara kerjanya, bukan sebagai saran keuangan.
segments.tr: Because figures are always moving, make sure you refer to official information for the latest prices, and treat this article as a guide to understanding how it works rather than as financial advice.
